description: This header file defines internal function prototypes for the Dslh Obj Entity object in the DSL Home Model implementation. It includes functions for managing object and variable entities, handling object records, and controlling notification settings, serving as an internal API for object entity management.

methods.name: DslhObjeoEnableForbidNotify
methods.description: Enables or disables notification forbidding for the object entity.

methods.name: DslhObjeoReset
methods.description: Resets the object entity to its default state.

methods.name: DslhObjeoGetObjEntity2
methods.description: Retrieves an object entity based on a token chain.

methods.name: DslhObjeoGetObjEntity3
methods.description: Retrieves the object entity, possibly the current or default one.

methods.name: DslhObjeoDelObjEntity
methods.description: Deletes an object entity by name.

methods.name: DslhObjeoAddVarEntity
methods.description: Adds a variable entity to the object.

methods.name: DslhObjeoDelVarEntity
methods.description: Deletes a variable entity by name.

methods.name: DslhObjeoGetVarEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a variable entity by name.

methods.name: DslhObjeoGetObjRecordCount
methods.description: Gets the count of object records.

methods.name: DslhObjeoGetObjRecordCount2
methods.description: Gets the count of object records matching a partial path.

methods.name: DslhObjeoGetObjRecord
methods.description: Retrieves an object record based on parameter name and value.

methods.name: DslhObjeoGetObjRecord2
methods.description: Retrieves an object record by partial path and index.

methods.name: DslhObjeoPopulateObjRecordByName
methods.description: Populates an object record by its name.

methods.name: DslhObjeoDeleteObjRecordByName
methods.description: Deletes an object record by name.
